params.caption: 🎮 Resident Evil movie's rough cut had far more swearing Director Zach Cregger says the rough cut of his Resident Evil film was "carpeted" with f-words, even more than the final version, where lead character Bryan (Austin Abrams) swears constantly in Raccoon City.
